scanNote: 9-mashqning 10-bandida ('That's not your coat. Its my.') AKTUALDA IKKI xato bor: 'Its' → 'It's' (apostrof) va 'my' → 'mine'. Kitobda faqat BITTA tuzatish katakchasi bor, shuning uchun asosiy javob 'mine'; apostrof masalasi ham alohida ko'rsatildi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue below and fill in can, can't, must or mustn't.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi dialogni o'qing va can, can't, must yoki mustn't ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
VAZIYAT: o'qituvchi bolalarni HAYVONOT BOG'IGA
olib bormoqda va qoidalarni tushuntiryapti.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  MUST
   2  MUSTN'T
   3  CAN
   4  CAN'T
   5  CAN
   6  CAN
   7  CAN
   8  MUSTN'T
   9  CAN
  10  MUST


TO'LIQ DIALOG (javoblar bilan):

  Teacher:  Okay children, today we are going
            to visit the zoo and there are some
            rules we MUST follow. First, you
            MUSTN'T feed the animals.

  Student:  CAN we touch the animals?

  Teacher:  No, you CAN'T! You are not allowed
            to touch the animals because it's
            dangerous.

  Student:  CAN we take pictures of the animals?

  Teacher:  Yes, you CAN. You CAN take pictures
            but you MUSTN'T bother them.

  Student:  CAN we go anywhere we want?

  Teacher:  No! Everyone MUST stay close to me.


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  O'qituvchi: Xo'p bolalar, bugun hayvonot
              bog'iga boramiz va bajarishimiz
              KERAK bo'lgan bir necha qoida bor.
              Birinchidan, hayvonlarni
              ovqatlantirMANG.
  O'quvchi:   Hayvonlarga tegsak BO'LADIMI?
  O'qituvchi: Yo'q, BO'LMAYDI! Hayvonlarga
              tegishga ruxsat yo'q, chunki bu
              xavfli.
  O'quvchi:   Hayvonlarni suratga olsak
              BO'LADIMI?
  O'qituvchi: Ha, BO'LADI. Suratga olishingiz
              MUMKIN, lekin ularni bezovta
              qilMANG.
  O'quvchi:   Xohlagan joyimizga borsak
              BO'LADIMI?
  O'qituvchi: Yo'q! Hamma menga yaqin turishi
              KERAK.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

  1  'rules we ... FOLLOW'
     Qoidaga AMAL QILISh — MAJBURIYAT.
     → MUST

  2  'you ... FEED the animals'
     Hayvonot bog'ida ovqatlantirish
     TAQIQLANGAN.
     → MUSTN'T

  3  '... we TOUCH the animals?'
     SAVOL — RUXSAT so'ralyapti.
     → CAN
     ('Must we touch?' = 'tegishimiz shartmi?'
      — ma'nosiz)

  4  'No, you ...!'
     QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni
     TAKRORLAYDI: 'Can we?' → 'you CAN'T'.
     Yana KALIT: 'You are NOT ALLOWED to touch'
     — grammatika qutisidagi ta'rif:
     'can't = you AREN'T ALLOWED to'.
     → CAN'T

  5  '... we TAKE PICTURES?'
     Yana RUXSAT savoli.
     → CAN

  6  'Yes, you ...'
     Qisqa javob: 'Can we?' → 'you CAN'.
     → CAN

  7  'You ... take pictures'
     O'qituvchi hozirgina ruxsat berdi.
     → CAN

  8  'but you ... BOTHER them'
     'BUT' — qarama-qarshilik: ruxsat bor,
     LEKIN taqiq ham bor.
     Bezovta qilish TAQIQLANGAN.
     → MUSTN'T

  9  '... we go anywhere we want?'
     RUXSAT savoli.
     → CAN

 10  'Everyone ... STAY CLOSE to me.'
     Bu — QAT'IY qoida ('No!' bilan
     boshlangan).
     → MUST


OLTIN QOIDA — MASHQNING TUZILIShI:

  O'QUVChI so'raydi  →  DOIM 'CAN ...?'
                        (3, 5, 9)
  O'QITUVChI javob:
     ruxsat beradi   →  CAN     (6, 7)
     rad etadi       →  CAN'T   (4)
     qoida aytadi    →  MUST    (1, 10)
     taqiqlaydi      →  MUSTN'T (2, 8)


DIQQAT — 4-BAND 'MUSTN'T' EMAS, 'CAN'T':
  Ikkalasi ham taqiq, lekin:
  • QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi
    ('Can we?' → 'you can't')
  • Matnning o'zi 'NOT ALLOWED' deydi —
    bu 'can't' ning ta'rifi


DIQQAT — 'ANYWHERE WE WANT':
  'anywhere (that) we want' = xohlagan
  joyimizga
  Coursebook 100-betdagi Yaponiya matnida ham
  bor edi: 'don't sit ANYWHERE YOU LIKE'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a zoo         = hayvonot bog'i
  to follow rules = qoidalarga amal qilmoq
  to feed       = ovqatlantirmoq
  to touch      = tegmoq
  allowed       = ruxsat etilgan
  dangerous     = xavfli
  to take pictures = suratga olmoq
  to bother     = bezovta qilmoq
  anywhere      = istalgan joyda
  close to      = ... ga yaqin

items.sentence: 1  Teacher: ... there are some rules we ................ follow.
items.uz: ... bajarishimiz kerak bo'lgan bir necha qoida bor.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'RULES' (qoidalar).
Qoidaga amal qilish — MAJBURIYAT → MUST.

Grammar 60-bet: 'We use must b) FOR RULES'.

items.sentence: 2  First, you .................... feed the animals.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Hayvonot bog'ida hayvonlarni ovqatlantirish
TAQIQLANGAN (ular kasal bo'lishi mumkin)
→ MUSTN'T.

'must feed' bo'lsa 'ovqatlantirishingiz SHART'
degan teskari ma'no chiqadi.

items.sentence: 3  Student: .................... we touch the animals?

commonMistake.whyUz:
O'quvchi RUXSAT so'rayapti → CAN ...?

'Must we touch the animals?' =
'hayvonlarga tegishimiz SHARTMI?' — ma'nosiz.

Mashqda o'quvchi UCH marta savol beradi
(3, 5, 9) va uchalasi ham 'CAN'.

items.sentence: 4  Teacher: No, you ....................! You are not allowed to touch the animals because it's dangerous.
items.uz: Yo'q, bo'lmaydi! Hayvonlarga tegishga ruxsat yo'q, chunki bu xavfli.

commonMistake.whyUz:
IKKI KALIT:

1) QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni TAKRORLAYDI:
   'CAN we touch?' → 'No, you CAN'T.'

2) Matnning o'zi aytadi: 'You are NOT ALLOWED
   to touch' — bu aynan 'can't' ning ta'rifi
   (Grammar 60-bet: 'can't = you AREN'T
   ALLOWED to').

Shuning uchun 'mustn't' emas, CAN'T.

items.sentence: 5  Student: .................... we take pictures of the animals?

commonMistake.whyUz:
Yana RUXSAT savoli → CAN.

'to take pictures OF something' — predlog 'of'.
('take pictures FOR' XATO)

QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi:
'CAN we take pictures?' → 'Yes, you CAN.'

Qisqa javobda fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

items.sentence: 7  You .................... take pictures but you ...

commonMistake.whyUz:
O'qituvchi hozirgina 'Yes, you can' dedi —
demak RUXSAT bor → CAN.

Bu — 6-bandning to'liq gap shakli.

KALIT: 'BUT' — qarama-qarshilik.
Ruxsat BOR, lekin chegara ham bor.

Hayvonlarni bezovta qilish TAQIQLANGAN
→ MUSTN'T.

'to bother' = bezovta qilmoq.

items.sentence: 9  Student: .................... we go anywhere we want?

commonMistake.whyUz:
O'quvchining UCHINCHI savoli — yana RUXSAT
→ CAN.

'anywhere (that) we want' = xohlagan joyimizga.
Coursebook 100-bet, Yaponiya matni:
'don't sit ANYWHERE YOU LIKE'.

items.sentence: 10  Teacher: No! Everyone .................... stay close to me.
items.uz: Yo'q! Hamma menga yaqin turishi kerak.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'NO!' undov bilan boshlangan — bu
QAT'IY qoida → MUST.

'EVERYONE' — III shaxs BIRLIK, lekin 'must'
baribir o'zgarmaydi ('everyone musts' XATO).

'close TO me' — predlog 'to'
(9-mashqning 7-bandi ham shu haqda).

exercises.explanationUz:
IBORALAR (4 ta):
  you should
  I think it's a good idea
  Why don't you
  I don't think it's a good idea

MATN: Tresi Lindaga xat yozgan (Rimga
ko'chib borish haqida). Rasmda Rim Kolizeyi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA
  2  I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA
  3  YOU SHOULD
  4  WHY DON'T YOU


TO'LIQ XAT (javoblar bilan):

                              6th May
  Dear Linda,

  I'm happy to hear that you are moving to
  Rome. I'm worried though, that you don't
  have a place to stay when you get there.

  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA to move to Rome,
  but I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA to stay
  at a hotel because hotels are very expensive
  in Rome. Maybe YOU SHOULD wait a little while
  and go when you find a flat. WHY DON'T YOU
  ask your friends there to look for a flat
  for you?

  Hope to hear from you soon.

                              Love,
                              Tracy


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  Hurmatli Linda,

  Rimga ko'chib ketayotganingni eshitib
  xursandman. Lekin u yerga borganingda
  turadigan joying yo'qligidan xavotirdaman.

  Menimcha, Rimga ko'chish yaxshi fikr, lekin
  mehmonxonada turish yaxshi fikr emas, chunki
  Rimda mehmonxonalar juda qimmat. Balki biroz
  kutib, kvartira topganingdan keyin borsang
  yaxshiroq. U yerdagi do'stlaringdan senga
  kvartira qidirishlarini so'rasang-chi?

  Tez orada javobingni kutaman.

  Mehr bilan, Tresi


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — FAQAT GRAMMATIKA!

  Har bo'shliqdan KEYINGI so'z javobni
  belgilab beradi:

  1  '... TO MOVE to Rome'
     Keyin 'TO + fe'l' keladi.
     'a good idea TO + fe'l' qurilmasi.
     Ma'no IJOBIY (Rimga ko'chish yaxshi).
     → I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA

  2  'BUT ... TO STAY at a hotel'
     Yana 'TO + fe'l', LEKIN oldida 'BUT' bor
     va sabab salbiy ('hotels are very
     EXPENSIVE').
     → I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA

  3  'Maybe ... WAIT a little while'
     Keyin 'to' SIZ fe'l ('wait') keladi!
     'should + ASOSIY fe'l' qurilmasi.
     → YOU SHOULD

  4  '... ASK your friends ... ?'
     Gap SAVOL BELGISI bilan tugaydi!
     Ro'yxatdagi yagona savol shakli —
     'Why don't you ...?'
     → WHY DON'T YOU


ENG MUHIM UCh BELGI:

  A) 'TO + fe'l' keladimi?
        → 'it's a good idea TO ...'
           (1 va 2-bandlar)

  B) 'to' SIZ fe'l keladimi?
        → 'you should + fe'l'
           (3-band)

  C) Gap oxirida SAVOL BELGISI bormi?
        → 'Why don't you ...?'
           (4-band)

  Bu uch belgi mashqni GRAMMATIK jihatdan
  butunlay hal qiladi — taxmin kerak emas.


DIQQAT — 1 va 2 NI QANDAY AJRATISh:
  Ikkalasida ham 'TO + fe'l' keladi.
  Farqi — MA'NODA:
     1  Rimga ko'chish — Tresi buni QO'LLAB-
        QUVVATLAYDI ('I'm happy to hear')
        → ijobiy
     2  'BUT' + 'hotels are very EXPENSIVE'
        → salbiy

  'BUT' so'zi qarama-qarshilikni ko'rsatib
  turibdi.


XAT TUZILIShI (norasmiy xat):
  Sana:        6th May (o'ng yuqorida)
  Murojaat:    Dear Linda,
  1-xatboshi:  sabab (nima uchun yozyapman)
  2-xatboshi:  maslahatlar
  Yakun:       Hope to hear from you soon.
  Imzo:        Love, Tracy


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to move to    = ... ga ko'chib bormoq
  worried       = xavotirda
  though        = lekin, biroq (gap o'rtasida
                  yoki oxirida)
  a place to stay = turadigan joy
  to get there  = u yerga yetib bormoq
  expensive     = qimmat
  a while       = biroz vaqt
  a flat        = kvartira
  to look for   = qidirmoq
  Hope to hear from you soon = Tez orada
                  javobingizni kutaman
wordList: I think it's a good idea
I don't think it's a good idea

items.answer: I think it's a good idea

commonMistake.whyUz:
GRAMMATIK KALIT: keyin 'TO MOVE' keladi —
ya'ni 'TO + fe'l'.
Bu qurilmani faqat 'it's a good idea TO ...'
talab qiladi.

MA'NO KALITI: Tresi Rimga ko'chishni
QO'LLAB-QUVVATLAYDI ('I'm happy to hear that
you are moving to Rome') → IJOBIY shakl.

items.sentence: 2  but ....................................... to stay at a hotel because hotels are very expensive in Rome.
items.answer: I don't think it's a good idea
items.uz: lekin mehmonxonada turish yaxshi fikr emas, chunki Rimda mehmonxonalar juda qimmat.

commonMistake.whyUz:
GRAMMATIK KALIT: keyin 'TO STAY' —
yana 'TO + fe'l'.

IKKI MA'NO KALITI:
  1) 'BUT' — qarama-qarshilik
  2) 'hotels are very EXPENSIVE' — salbiy sabab

Demak SALBIY shakl → I DON'T THINK ...

DIQQAT: inkor BOSH gapga qo'yiladi
('I DON'T think', 'I think it ISN'T' emas).

items.sentence: 3  Maybe ....................................... wait a little while and go when you find a flat.
items.uz: Balki biroz kutib, kvartira topganingdan keyin borsang yaxshiroq.

commonMistake.whyUz:
GRAMMATIK KALIT: keyin 'WAIT' keladi —
'TO' SIZ asosiy fe'l!

Bu qurilmani faqat 'you SHOULD + fe'l'
talab qiladi.
  'you should WAIT'                    ✓
  'it's a good idea WAIT'              ✗
   (bu yerda 'TO wait' kerak bo'lardi)

'a little while' = biroz vaqt.

items.sentence: 4  ....................................... ask your friends there to look for a flat for you?
items.uz: U yerdagi do'stlaringdan senga kvartira qidirishlarini so'rasang-chi?

commonMistake.whyUz:
ENG ANIQ KALIT: gap SAVOL BELGISI (?) bilan
tugaydi!

Ro'yxatdagi to'rt iboradan faqat BITTASI
savol shaklida: 'Why don't you ...?'

Yana: keyin 'ASK' — 'to' siz asosiy fe'l
('Why don't you + ASOSIY fe'l?').

'to look FOR' = qidirmoq (predlog 'for').

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in can, can't, could or couldn't.
exercises.instructionUz: can, can't, could yoki couldn't ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  COULDN'T ... CAN
  2  CAN
  3  COULD
  4  CAN'T
  5  CAN
  6  COULDN'T
  7  COULDN'T ... CAN
  8  COULD


TO'LIQ GAPLAR VA TARJIMASI:

 1  Michael COULDN'T use a computer when he was
    two but he CAN now.
    (Maykl ikki yoshida kompyuterdan
     foydalana olmasdi, lekin hozir oladi.)

 2  Sally is from Paris. She CAN speak French.
    (Salli Parijdan. U fransuzcha gapira oladi.)

 3  COULD you play football when you were five?
    (Besh yoshingizda futbol o'ynay olarmidingiz?)

 4  I CAN'T go to the cinema. I must study for
    a test.
    (Kinoga bora olmayman. Nazorat ishiga
     tayyorlanishim kerak.)

 5  Paul is a chef. He CAN make many delicious
    dishes.
    (Pol oshpaz. U ko'p mazali taomlar tayyorlay
     oladi.)

 6  I lost my keys and I COULDN'T find them
    anywhere.
    (Kalitlarimni yo'qotdim va ularni hech
     qayerdan topa olmadim.)

 7  I COULDN'T count when I was three but I CAN
    now.
    (Uch yoshimda sanay olmasdim, lekin hozir
     olaman.)

 8  COULD you ride a bicycle when you were four?
    (To'rt yoshingizda velosiped mina
     olarmidingiz?)


OLTIN QOIDA — VAQT BELGISINI TOPING:

  O'TGAN ZAMON belgisi bo'lsa  →  COULD/COULDN'T
     'when he WAS two'
     'when you WERE five'
     'when I WAS three'
     'when you WERE four'
     'I LOST my keys'

  HOZIRGI ZAMON belgisi bo'lsa  →  CAN/CAN'T
     'but he ... NOW'
     'She IS from Paris'
     'Paul IS a chef'
     'I MUST study' (hozirgi majburiyat)

  Ya'ni GAPDAGI BOSHQA FE'L zamonni aytib
  turibdi!


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  IKKI BO'SHLIQ, IKKI ZAMON:
       'when he WAS two'  → o'tgan → COULDN'T
       'but he ... NOW'   → hozir  → CAN
    Ma'no: ikki yoshida bilmasdi, hozir biladi.
    Shuning uchun birinchisi INKOR, ikkinchisi
    TASDIQ.

 2  'She IS from Paris' — hozirgi zamon.
    Parijliklar fransuzcha gapiradi → QOBILIYAT
    bor.
    → CAN

 3  'when you WERE five' — o'tgan zamon.
    SAVOL shakli → COULD egadan oldin.
    → COULD

 4  'I MUST study for a test' — hozirgi
    majburiyat, shuning uchun kinoga bora
    olmaydi.
    → CAN'T

 5  'Paul IS a chef' — hozirgi zamon.
    Oshpaz — demak QOBILIYATI bor.
    → CAN

 6  'I LOST my keys' — o'tgan zamon (lost).
    Shuning uchun keyingi fe'l ham o'tgan
    zamonda.
    → COULDN'T
    ('anywhere' — inkor gapda 'hech qayerda')

 7  1-band bilan AYNAN bir xil tuzilish:
       'when I WAS three' → COULDN'T
       'but I ... NOW'    → CAN

 8  3-band bilan bir xil: 'when you WERE four'
    → savol, o'tgan zamon
    → COULD


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDA 'ANYWHERE':
  'I couldn't find them ANYWHERE.'
  = hech qayerdan topa olmadim

  INKOR gapda 'anywhere' = 'hech qayerda'.
  TASDIQ gapda 'anywhere' = 'istalgan joyda'
  (5-mashqning 9-bandidagidek).

  Bir so'z, gap shakliga qarab ikki ma'no!


DIQQAT — 'CAN' QOBILIYAT MI, RUXSAT MI:
  Bu mashqda hammasi QOBILIYAT (ability):
     use a computer, speak French, play
     football, make dishes, count, ride a
     bicycle

  4-bandda esa boshqacha: 'I CAN'T go to the
  cinema' — bu qobiliyat emas, VAZIYAT
  (imkoni yo'q, chunki o'qishi kerak).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to use a computer = kompyuterdan foydalanmoq
  French            = fransuz tili
  a chef            = oshpaz (professional)
  delicious         = mazali
  a dish            = taom; likopcha
  to lose           = yo'qotmoq (lose → LOST)
  keys              = kalitlar
  anywhere          = hech qayerda (inkorda)
  to count          = sanamoq
  a bicycle         = velosiped

items.sentence: 1a  Michael .................. use a computer when he was two ...
items.uz: Maykl ikki yoshida kompyuterdan foydalana olmasdi ...

commonMistake.whyUz:
VAQT KALITI: 'when he WAS two' — O'TGAN zamon
('was' fe'li).

MA'NO KALITI: ikki yoshli bola kompyuterdan
foydalana olmaydi → INKOR.

→ COULDN'T

VAQT KALITI: 'NOW' — HOZIRGI zamon.

'BUT' — qarama-qarshilik: avval bilmasdi,
endi biladi → TASDIQ.

→ CAN

Qisqa javobda fe'l takrorlanmaydi:
'he can' ('he can use a computer' o'rniga).

items.sentence: 2  Sally is from Paris. She ................ speak French.
items.uz: Salli Parijdan. U fransuzcha gapira oladi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
VAQT KALITI: 'She IS from Paris' — HOZIRGI
zamon.

MA'NO KALITI: Parij — Fransiyaning poytaxti,
demak fransuzcha biladi → QOBILIYAT bor.

→ CAN

'speak French' — til nomi oldida artikl YO'Q.

items.sentence: 3  ................ you play football when you were five?

commonMistake.whyUz:
VAQT KALITI: 'when you WERE five' — O'TGAN
zamon ('were').

SHAKL: bu SAVOL — modal egadan OLDIN turadi.

→ COULD

'Did you could play?' — XATO ('do' kerak emas).

items.sentence: 4  I ..................... go to the cinema. I must study for a test.
items.uz: Kinoga bora olmayman. Nazorat ishiga tayyorlanishim kerak.

commonMistake.whyUz:
VAQT KALITI: 'I MUST study' — HOZIRGI
majburiyat.

MA'NO KALITI: o'qishi kerak, demak kinoga
bora OLMAYDI → INKOR.

→ CAN'T

DIQQAT: bu QOBILIYAT emas, VAZIYAT (imkoni
yo'q).
'study FOR a test' — predlog 'for'.

items.sentence: 5  Paul is a chef. He .................. make many delicious dishes.
items.uz: Pol oshpaz. U ko'p mazali taomlar tayyorlay oladi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
VAQT KALITI: 'Paul IS a chef' — HOZIRGI zamon.

MA'NO KALITI: oshpaz bo'lsa, taom tayyorlashni
BILADI → QOBILIYAT.

→ CAN

'a chef' = professional oshpaz
('a cook' — umumiy).
'many dishES' — sanaladigan, shuning uchun
'many'.

items.sentence: 6  I lost my keys and I .......................... find them anywhere.
items.uz: Kalitlarimni yo'qotdim va ularni hech qayerdan topa olmadim.

commonMistake.whyUz:
VAQT KALITI: 'I LOST my keys' — O'TGAN zamon
(lose → LOST).

Bir gapdagi ikki fe'l odatda BIR zamonda
bo'ladi → COULDN'T.

MA'NO: yo'qotdi va topa olmadi → INKOR.

DIQQAT — 'ANYWHERE' INKORDA:
'couldn't find them ANYWHERE' = HECH QAYERDAN
topa olmadim.
(Tasdiq gapda 'anywhere' = istalgan joyda.)

items.sentence: 7a  I ........................ count when I was three ...

commonMistake.whyUz:
VAQT KALITI: 'when I WAS three' — O'TGAN zamon.

MA'NO: uch yoshli bola sanay olmaydi → INKOR.

→ COULDN'T

1-band bilan AYNAN bir xil tuzilish.

VAQT KALITI: 'NOW' — HOZIRGI zamon.
'BUT' — qarama-qarshilik → TASDIQ.

→ CAN

1b-band bilan bir xil.

items.sentence: 8  .............. you ride a bicycle when you were four?

commonMistake.whyUz:
VAQT KALITI: 'when you WERE four' — O'TGAN
zamon.

SHAKL: SAVOL — modal egadan OLDIN.

→ COULD

3-band bilan bir xil.
'to RIDE a bicycle' (Grammar 61-bet, D belgisi).

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  MUSTN'T
  2  MUST
  3  MUST
  4  MUSTN'T
  5  MUSTN'T
  6  MUST


TO'LIQ GAPLAR VA TARJIMASI:

 1  It's cold. You MUSTN'T leave without your
    jacket.
    (Sovuq. Kurtkasiz chiqmang.)

 2  You MUST eat fruit and vegetables to stay
    healthy.
    (Sog'lom bo'lish uchun meva va sabzavot
     yeyishingiz kerak.)

 3  I MUST go to the post office. I have a
    letter to send.
    (Pochtaga borishim kerak. Yuboradigan
     xatim bor.)

 4  You MUSTN'T speak rudely to your parents.
    (Ota-onangizga qo'pol gapirmang.)

 5  You MUSTN'T park here — it's illegal.
    (Bu yerga mashina qo'ymang — qonunga
     xilof.)

 6  We MUST hurry or we'll miss the bus.
    (Shoshilishimiz kerak, aks holda
     avtobusdan qolamiz.)


HAR BIRIDA SABAB GAPNING ICHIDA:

 1  'IT'S COLD.'
    → kurtkasiz chiqish XAVFLI → MUSTN'T

 2  'TO STAY HEALTHY'
    → maqsad IJOBIY → MUST

 3  'I HAVE A LETTER TO SEND.'
    → sabab bor, borish KERAK → MUST

 4  'RUDELY' (qo'pol)
    → qo'pollik TAQIQLANGAN → MUSTN'T

 5  'IT'S ILLEGAL.'
    → qonun taqiqlagan → MUSTN'T
    (Coursebook 102-bet, 16e-dialog bilan
     AYNAN bir xil!)

 6  'OR WE'LL MISS THE BUS.'
    → 'or' = aks holda; shoshilish ZARUR
    → MUST


OLTIN QOIDA:
  Har bandda IKKINCHI qism (sabab) javobni
  belgilaydi.
     Sabab SALBIY/XAVFLI  →  MUSTN'T
     Sabab MAQSAD/ZARURAT →  MUST


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI 'OR':
  'We must hurry OR we'll miss the bus.'
  'or' = aks holda

  Coursebook 100-betdagi Angliya matnida ham
  bor edi:
  'Never push into a queue OR they'll get
   angry.'

  Tuzilishi:
     [buyruq/must] + OR + [will bilan natija]


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDA 'RUDELY':
  'speak RUDELY' — RAVISH (fe'lni izohlaydi)
  'be RUDE' — SIFAT

     'He speaks rudely.'  ✓ (ravish)
     'He is rude.'        ✓ (sifat)
     'He speaks rude.'    ✗

  Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy matni:
  'it's very RUDE' (sifat).


DIQQAT — 3-BANDDA 'A LETTER TO SEND':
  'I have a letter TO SEND.'
  = yuboradigan xatim bor

  'ot + TO + fe'l' qurilmasi:
     something to eat   = yeydigan narsa
     a place to stay    = turadigan joy
                          (6-mashqdagi xatda!)
     work to do         = qiladigan ish


DIQQAT — 1-BANDDA 'WITHOUT':
  'leave WITHOUT your jacket' = kurtkasiz
  chiqmoq
  'without' — predlog, keyin OT yoki -ING:
     without a jacket
     without eating


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to leave        = chiqmoq, ketmoq
  without         = ...siz
  a jacket        = kurtka
  to stay healthy = sog'lom bo'lib turmoq
  the post office = pochta bo'limi
  to send         = yubormoq (send → SENT)
  rudely          = qo'pol tarzda
  parents         = ota-ona
  illegal         = qonunga xilof
  to hurry        = shoshilmoq
  to miss the bus = avtobusdan qolmoq

items.sentence: 1  It's cold. You .............. leave without your jacket.

commonMistake.whyUz:
SABAB KALITI: 'IT'S COLD' — sovuq.
Kurtkasiz chiqish — SHAMOLLASH xavfi → MUSTN'T.

'must leave without your jacket' bo'lsa
'kurtkasiz chiqishingiz SHART' degan teskari
ma'no chiqadi.

'without + OT' — predlog.

items.sentence: 2  You ......................... eat fruit and vegetables to stay healthy.
items.uz: Sog'lom bo'lish uchun meva va sabzavot yeyishingiz kerak.

commonMistake.whyUz:
MAQSAD KALITI: 'TO STAY HEALTHY' — sog'lom
bo'lish uchun.
Maqsad IJOBIY → MUST.

Coursebook 98-bet, 1-mashq (c-band):
'Eat lots of fruit and vegetables.' (health)

'TO stay' — MAQSAD to-infinitive.

items.sentence: 3  I ......................... go to the post office. I have a letter to send.
items.uz: Pochtaga borishim kerak. Yuboradigan xatim bor.

commonMistake.whyUz:
SABAB KALITI: 'I HAVE A LETTER TO SEND' —
yuboradigan xat bor, demak borish ZARUR → MUST.

'a letter TO SEND' — 'ot + TO + fe'l' qurilmasi
(yuboradigan xat).

DIQQAT: bu bandda ega 'I' — o'zi o'ziga
majburiyat qo'yyapti (ichki zarurat).

items.sentence: 4  You .................... speak rudely to your parents.

commonMistake.whyUz:
MA'NO KALITI: 'RUDELY' (qo'pol tarzda) —
qo'pollik hech qachon IJOBIY bo'lmaydi
→ MUSTN'T.

'speak RUDELY' — RAVISH (fe'lni izohlaydi).
'be RUDE' — SIFAT.

Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy matni:
'it's very RUDE'.

items.sentence: 5  You .................... park here — it's illegal.
items.uz: Bu yerga mashina qo'ymang — qonunga xilof.

commonMistake.whyUz:
SABAB KALITI: 'IT'S ILLEGAL' (qonunga xilof)
— QONUNIY taqiq → MUSTN'T.

Grammar 60-bet ta'rifi:
'mustn't means it is FORBIDDEN ... it is
AGAINST THE RULE'.

Coursebook 102-bet, 16e-dialog AYNAN shu:
'You mustn't park here — it's illegal.'

items.sentence: 6  We .................... hurry or we'll miss the bus.
items.uz: Shoshilishimiz kerak, aks holda avtobusdan qolamiz.

commonMistake.whyUz:
MANTIQ KALITI: 'OR WE'LL MISS THE BUS' —
aks holda avtobusdan qolamiz.
Demak shoshilish ZARUR → MUST.

'OR' bu yerda = 'aks holda'.
Tuzilishi: [must + fe'l] + OR + [will bilan
natija].

Coursebook 100-bet, Angliya matni:
'Never push into a queue OR they'll get angry.'

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
1-14 UNITLARNI QAMRAB OLUVCHI TAKRORLASh.
Har bandda BITTA so'z xato — uni to'g'risi
bilan almashtirish kerak.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  in    →  OF      (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)
   2  because → SO
   3  There →  IT
   4  must  →  MUSTN'T
   5  as    →  THAN
   6  fastly →  FAST
   7  from  →  TO
   8  Will  →  WOULD
   9  mine  →  MY
  10  my    →  MINE
  11  Do    →  CAN
  12  Where →  WHAT
  13  for   →  TO
  14  some  →  A


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  'It's the most comfortable flat IN all.'
    → 'the most comfortable flat OF all'
    USTUN DARAJADA guruh 'OF' bilan beriladi:
       the best OF all
       the biggest OF the three
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA — 'of' yozib qo'yilgan)

 2  'Tonia is saving some money BECAUSE she
     can go on holiday next year.'
    → '... SO she can go on holiday next year.'
    Tonia pul yig'yapti — MAQSAD uchun
    (ta'tilga borish uchun), sabab uchun emas.
    'because' — SABAB (nima uchun sodir bo'ldi)
    'so' — MAQSAD/NATIJA (nima uchun qilyapti)
    ('so that' ham to'g'ri, lekin bir so'z
     kerak bo'lsa — 'so')

 3  'THERE will be hot and sunny at the
     weekend.'
    → 'IT will be hot and sunny at the weekend.'
    Ob-havo haqida gapirganda ega — 'IT'.
       It is cold.  It will be sunny.
    'There is/are' — MAVJUDLIK uchun:
       'There will be a storm.' ✓ (ot bilan)
       'There will be sunny.'   ✗ (sifat bilan)

 4  'You MUST talk during the test.'
    → 'You MUSTN'T talk during the test.'
    Nazorat ishi paytida gapirish TAQIQLANGAN.
    'must talk' = 'gapirishingiz shart' —
    mantiqan noto'g'ri.

 5  'This car is cheaper AS that one.'
    → 'This car is cheaper THAN that one.'
    QIYOSIY daraja DOIM 'THAN' bilan:
       cheaper THAN, bigger THAN, better THAN
    'AS ... AS' — TENGLIK uchun:
       'as cheap AS that one' (bir xil narxda)

 6  'Don't talk so FASTLY.'
    → 'Don't talk so FAST.'
    'FAST' — ham SIFAT, ham RAVISH.
    'fastly' degan so'z INGLIZ TILIDA YO'Q!
    Shu kabi: hard, late, early, high
       'work HARD'  ✓  'work HARDLY' — boshqa
                        ma'no (deyarli emas)

 7  'My school is close FROM my house.'
    → 'My school is close TO my house.'
    'close TO' — turg'un birikma.
    'far FROM' — teskarisi 'from' bilan!
       close TO ✓   /   far FROM ✓
       close FROM ✗  /  far TO ✗

 8  'WILL you like a cup of tea?'
    → 'WOULD you like a cup of tea?'
    'Would you like ...?' — taklif qilish
    (choy, ovqat va h.k.).
    'Will you like ...?' = 'kelajakda yoqadimi?'
    — boshqa ma'no.

 9  'She's MINE niece.'
    → 'She's MY niece.'
    OT oldida — MY (egalik SIFATI)
    OT o'rniga — MINE (egalik OLMOSHI)
       my niece ✓  /  mine niece ✗

10  'That's not your coat. Its MY.'
    → 'It's MINE.'
    OT o'rniga — MINE.
    9-bandning TESKARISI: kitob ataylab ikkalasini
    yonma-yon bergan.
    ⚠ DIQQAT: bu bandda AKTUALDA IKKI xato bor —
    'Its' ham 'It's' bo'lishi kerak (apostrof).
    Kitobda bitta katakcha bor, shuning uchun
    asosiy javob MINE.

11  'I can't swim. DO you?'
    → 'CAN you?'
    Qisqa savol ASOSIY gapdagi yordamchi/modal
    fe'lni takrorlaydi:
       'I CAN'T swim. CAN you?'
       'I DON'T like it. DO you?'
       'I AM tired. ARE you?'

12  'I'm Italian. WHERE about you?'
    → 'WHAT about you?'
    'What about you?' = Sizchi?
    Turg'un ibora — 'where' bilan ishlatilmaydi.

13  'Banks are open from 9 am FOR 3 pm.'
    → 'from 9 am TO 3 pm'
    'FROM ... TO ...' — vaqt oralig'i.
    'for' — davomiylik ('for 3 hours').
    Yana: 'from ... UNTIL/TILL ...' ham to'g'ri.

14  'I'd like SOME bottle of water, please.'
    → 'A bottle of water'
    'bottle' — SANALADIGAN va BIRLIKDA,
    demak 'A' kerak.
    'some' ko'plik yoki sanalmaydigan bilan:
       some bottles ✓  /  some water ✓
       some bottle  ✗


GURUHLAR BO'YIChA (qaysi unitdan):

  ARTIKL/EGALIK:  9, 10, 14
  QIYOSLASh:      1, 5
  PREDLOG:        7, 13
  MODAL:          4, 11
  RAVISh:         6
  OB-HAVO 'IT':   3
  BOG'LOVChI:     2
  TURG'UN IBORA:  8, 12


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  comfortable   = qulay
  to save money = pul yig'moq
  during        = ... davomida
  cheap         = arzon
  close to      = ... ga yaqin
  far from      = ... dan uzoq
  a niece       = jiyan (qiz)
  a nephew      = jiyan (o'g'il)
  a coat        = palto
  Italian       = italiyalik
  a bottle      = shisha, butilka

items.sentence: 1  It's the most comfortable flat IN all.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA ('of' yozib qo'yilgan).

USTUN darajada guruh 'OF' bilan beriladi:
  the best OF all
  the biggest OF the three
  the most comfortable OF all

'in all' — bunday qurilma yo'q.

items.sentence: 2  Tonia is saving some money BECAUSE she can go on holiday next year.
items.uz: Toniya kelasi yili ta'tilga borishi uchun pul yig'yapti.

commonMistake.whyUz:
MANTIQ: Toniya pulni MAQSAD uchun yig'yapti
(ta'tilga borish uchun) — sabab uchun emas.

'BECAUSE' — SABAB (nima uchun sodir bo'lgan)
'SO' — MAQSAD/NATIJA (nima uchun qilyapti)

'Tonia is saving money SO she can go on
holiday.' ✓

('SO THAT' ham to'g'ri, lekin bitta so'z
kerak bo'lsa — 'so'.)

items.sentence: 3  THERE will be hot and sunny at the weekend.
items.uz: Dam olish kunlari issiq va quyoshli bo'ladi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
OB-HAVO haqida gapirganda ega DOIM 'IT':
  IT is cold.
  IT will be sunny.
  IT was raining.

'THERE is/are/will be' — MAVJUDLIK uchun va
undan keyin OT keladi:
  'There will be A STORM.'  ✓ (ot)
  'There will be SUNNY.'    ✗ (sifat)

DIQQAT: Grammar 59-betdagi 10-mashqda ham
aynan shu xato bor edi.

items.sentence: 4  You MUST talk during the test.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Nazorat ishida gapirish TAQIQLANGAN → MUSTN'T.

'You must talk during the test' =
'gapirishingiz SHART' — mantiqan noto'g'ri.

Coursebook 102-bet, 13a: darsda jim bo'lish
kerak; nusxa ko'chirish taqiqlangan.

'DURING the test' = nazorat ishi davomida.

items.sentence: 5  This car is cheaper AS that one.

commonMistake.whyUz:
QIYOSIY daraja DOIM 'THAN' bilan:
  cheapER THAN, biggER THAN, bettER THAN

'AS ... AS' — TENGLIK uchun:
  'as cheap AS that one' (bir xil narxda)

Bu yerda '-ER' qo'shimchasi bor, demak
QIYOS — 'than' kerak.

items.sentence: 6  Don't talk so FASTLY.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'FASTLY' degan so'z INGLIZ TILIDA YO'Q!

'FAST' — ham SIFAT, ham RAVISH:
  'a fast car'    (sifat)
  'drive fast'    (ravish)

Shu kabi so'zlar (-ly OLMAYDI):
  hard, late, early, high, straight

DIQQAT: 'hardly' bor, lekin ma'nosi BOSHQA
('deyarli emas').

items.sentence: 7  My school is close FROM my house.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'CLOSE TO' — turg'un birikma.

TESKARISI 'from' bilan:
  close TO   ✓   (yaqin)
  far FROM   ✓   (uzoq)
  close FROM ✗
  far TO     ✗

Grammar 62-bet, 5-mashqning 10-bandi ham:
'stay close TO me'.

items.sentence: 8  WILL you like a cup of tea?

commonMistake.whyUz:
'WOULD you like ...?' — TAKLIF qilish
(choy, ovqat, yordam).

'WILL you like ...?' = 'kelajakda sizga
yoqadimi?' — butunlay boshqa ma'no.

Javobi: 'Yes, please.' / 'No, thank you.'

'a cup of tea' — 'tea' sanalmaydigan,
shuning uchun 'a CUP OF'.

items.sentence: 9  Sonia is my brother's daughter. She's MINE niece.
items.uz: Soniya akamning qizi. U mening jiyanim.

commonMistake.whyUz:
OT OLDIDA — 'MY' (egalik SIFATI):
  MY niece, MY book, MY house

'MINE' — OT O'RNIGA (egalik OLMOSHI):
  'This book is MINE.'

  my + OT    ✓
  mine + OT  ✗

DIQQAT: 10-band bu bandning TESKARISI —
kitob ataylab ikkalasini bergan.

'a niece' = qiz jiyan; 'a nephew' = o'g'il jiyan.

items.sentence: 10  That's not your coat. Its MY.
items.uz: Bu sizning paltongiz emas. Bu meniki.

commonMistake.whyUz:
OT O'RNIGA — 'MINE' (egalik OLMOSHI):
  'It's MINE.' ✓
  'It's MY.'   ✗ (keyin ot kerak bo'lardi)

9-bandning TESKARISI:
  9  ot BOR  → my
  10 ot YO'Q → mine

⚠ DIQQAT — BU BANDDA IKKI XATO BOR:
  'ITS my'  →  'IT'S mine'
  'Its' (egalik, apostrofsiz) va
  'It's' (it is, apostrof bilan) — boshqa so'z!

Kitobda bitta katakcha bo'lgani uchun asosiy
javob MINE, lekin apostrof ham qo'yilishi
kerak.

items.sentence: 11  I can't swim. DO you?

commonMistake.whyUz:
QISQA SAVOL asosiy gapdagi YORDAMCHI yoki
MODAL fe'lni TAKRORLAYDI:

  'I CAN'T swim.  CAN you?'    ✓
  'I DON'T like it. DO you?'   ✓
  'I AM tired.  ARE you?'      ✓

Asosiy gapda 'can't' bor, demak qisqa savolda
ham 'Can' bo'lishi kerak — 'Do' emas.

items.sentence: 12  I'm Italian. WHERE about you?

commonMistake.whyUz:
'WHAT about you?' = Sizchi?

Bu TURG'UN IBORA — faqat 'what' bilan
ishlatiladi:
  What about you?    ✓
  What about tea?    ✓
  Where about you?   ✗

'How about you?' ham to'g'ri (bir xil ma'no).

items.sentence: 13  Banks are open from 9 am FOR 3 pm.
items.uz: Banklar ertalab 9 dan kechqurun 3 gacha ochiq.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'FROM ... TO ...' — vaqt ORALIG'I:
  from 9 am TO 3 pm
  from Monday TO Friday

'FOR' — DAVOMIYLIK:
  'for 3 hours' (uch soat davomida)

Gapda 'FROM' bor, demak juftligi 'TO' bo'lishi
kerak.
('from ... UNTIL/TILL ...' ham to'g'ri.)

items.sentence: 14  I'd like SOME bottle of water, please.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'bottle' — SANALADIGAN ot va BIRLIKDA,
demak ARTIKL 'A' kerak.

'SOME' faqat KO'PLIK yoki SANALMAYDIGAN bilan:
  some bottleS   ✓ (ko'plik)
  some water     ✓ (sanalmaydigan)
  some bottle    ✗ (birlik sanaladigan)

'I'd like' = 'I would like' — 8-band bilan
bog'liq.

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar 62-bet — modal mashqlari va 1-14 unitlar takrori.

items.base: I think it's a good idea
I don't think it's a good idea

groups.explanationUz: 1-14 unitlarning eng ko'p xato qilinadigan joylari.

patterns.formula: CAN + [EGA] + [fe'l]?  —  Yes, you CAN. / No, you CAN'T.
patterns.exampleEn: Can we touch the animals? — No, you can't. Can we take pictures? — Yes, you can.
patterns.exampleUz: Hayvonlarga tegsak bo'ladimi? — Yo'q. Suratga olsak bo'ladimi? — Ha.
patterns.explanationUz:
QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi.
'You are NOT ALLOWED to' = 'you CAN'T'.

patterns.exampleEn: You can take pictures but you mustn't bother them.
patterns.exampleUz: Suratga olishingiz mumkin, lekin ularni bezovta qilmang.

patterns.formula: [COULD/COULDN'T] + [fe'l] + WHEN I WAS [yosh], BUT I [CAN/CAN'T] NOW.
patterns.exampleEn: I couldn't count when I was three but I can now.
patterns.exampleUz: Uch yoshimda sanay olmasdim, lekin hozir olaman.
patterns.explanationUz:
Vaqt belgisi modalni tanlaydi:
'when I WAS' → could
'NOW' → can

patterns.exampleEn: We must hurry or we'll miss the bus.
patterns.exampleUz: Shoshilishimiz kerak, aks holda avtobusdan qolamiz.
patterns.explanationUz:
'OR' bu yerda = 'aks holda'.
CB 100-bet: 'Never push into a queue OR
they'll get angry.'

patterns.formula: IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO + [fe'l]   /   YOU SHOULD + [fe'l]   /   WHY DON'T YOU + [fe'l]?
patterns.exampleEn: I think it's a good idea to move to Rome. Maybe you should wait. Why don't you ask your friends?
patterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, Rimga ko'chish yaxshi fikr. Balki kutsang. Do'stlaringdan so'rasang-chi?
patterns.explanationUz:
Keyingi so'z qaysi ibora ekanini belgilaydi:
'TO + fe'l' → good idea
'fe'l' (to siz) → should
'?' → Why don't you

patterns.exampleEn: She's my niece. That's not your coat. It's mine.
patterns.exampleUz: U mening jiyanim. Bu sizning paltongiz emas. Bu meniki.
patterns.explanationUz:
OT BOR → my (egalik SIFATI)
OT YO'Q → mine (egalik OLMOSHI)
